A tab of el_tabs()

Source: R/el_items.R
el_tab_pane.Rd

Element Plus's el-tab-pane, for el_tabs(tabs =) and update_el_tabs(): el_tabs("t", tabs = list(el_tab_pane("One", ...), el_tab_pane("Two", ...))).

Usage

el_tab_pane(
  label,
  ...,
  name = label,
  disabled = NULL,
  closable = NULL,
  lazy = NULL
)

Arguments

label

Title of the tab.

...

The tab's content: tags, text, this package's components.

name

The tab's value, input$<id> while it is selected. Defaults to label.

disabled

Whether the tab is disabled.

closable

Whether this tab can be closed, when the tabs' own closable is off.

lazy

Render the content only when the tab is first selected. Its components do not exist, and report nothing, until then.

Value

A tab, for el_tabs(tabs =).

See also

Other items: el_anchor_link(), el_breadcrumb_item(), el_carousel_item(), el_collapse_item(), el_descriptions_item(), el_dropdown_item(), el_menu_item(), el_option(), el_skeleton_item(), el_step(), el_table_column(), el_table_v2_column(), el_timeline_item(), el_tour_step()

Examples

el_tabs(
  "t",
  tabs = list(
    el_tab_pane("User", "User settings"),
    el_tab_pane("Config", el_switch("dark"), lazy = TRUE)
  )
)
